releases.notes:
# Added

- Power button (#317) default action is now a clean shut down (requesting the guest to shut down). Shift+click reboots, Ctrl+click cuts power.
  - Linux handles this through a new poweroff/reboot driver.
  - On a Z80 the button falls back to a hard stop or restart.

# Changed

⚠️ Really breaking ⚠️ 

Shut down computers before updating. If you copied the bundled Lua/MicroPython libraries to a drive, those must be replaced with the new versions.

- HLAPI (RPC) protocol changed (multi-blob support, checksums are now CRC32). This is why the libs need updating.
- MLAPI memory address changed
  - RISC-V: moved from 0x03000000 to 0x10000000.
  - Z80: now comes after other built-in devices, so its port has changed.
- Interrupts: dynamically assigned interrupts are now allocated from high to low. New system controller interrupt uses 7, so this can conflict with saved state.
- Finding devices by name now takes a list of names and returns the devices that match all of them (#316):
  - Lua `bus:find(...)` and Python `bus.find(*names)`.
  - C `mlapi_find(nth, name, ...)` (argument order changed).
  - Z80 `OCFIND` takes a list of names ending in a double zero byte.
  - The C helper names were also changed to match the Z80 library.

All of this just to make clear: don't be surprised if things break during this upgrade. It's a bit of a pain, but it's some direly needed cleanup that should also avoid such breakages going forward.

# Fixed

- Fixed a client crash when enchanted armor or elytra is rendered in the projector depth pass (#325).
- Fixed the world flickering near a projector while it rains (#321).
- Clean reset of the RISC-V board on reboot. The HLAPI state now also resets on boot.

releases.notes:
# Added

- Tank operations module
- Built-in fluid tank for robots
- Devices for more vanilla blocks
- Inventory operations module can interact with container items now
- MLAPI events
- MLAPI available to RISC-V/Linux via `/dev/uio0`
- MLAPI support on more devices

# Changed

- [BREAKING] Transposer: unified some methods into `moveItems`/`moveFluid`
- [BREAKING] MLAPI `IOMethod.invoke` takes an object with args and possibility to consume energy now
- Transposer now charges energy on move operations
- Inventory module charges energy on move operations instead of per tick

# Fixed

- Fabric: chargers not charging items.
